snippet.description:
In this session, Vishal Pattnaik (AIR 341, UPSC CSE 2025) shares 5 important lessons from UPSC Prelims 2026 and explains how aspirants can use them to improve their preparation for the 2027 examination.

Enrol in Prelims Master Program (PMP) 2027: Enrol in PMP 2027: https://shorturl.at/ZHr3s

Download 100-Day UPSC Prelims Planner: https://shorturl.at/AIM0E

The discussion covers:

- Changing Question Patterns: Understanding the shift towards lengthy, unconventional and application-based questions.
- Polity Preparation: The importance of detailed reading of the Constitution, Bare Acts and lesser-covered provisions.
- Economy & Science and Technology: Building conceptual clarity and understanding how concepts work in practical situations.
- Geography & Environment: Using maps and connecting geographical features with current affairs.
- Beyond Elimination: Why conceptual understanding, comprehension and logical reasoning matter more than relying on shortcuts.
- Prelims Preparation Strategy: Source consolidation, regular tests, revision, mistake analysis and better decision-making in the examination hall.

If you are preparing for UPSC CSE 2027, this session will help you understand what Prelims 2026 revealed about the examination and identify the areas that deserve greater attention in your preparation.
